lines.6: Haan, dono tareeqe ek hi baat dikhate hain: 46 se 100 tak ka jump 54 hai. 30 ka partner?

lines.2: Rohan ne stadium pura bhara dekha—“pura sheher” wali tumhari baat mazedaar hai; end mein lautenge. 2,400 mein thousands box mein kya aayega?
lines.3: Thousands place mein 2 aata hai; ab hundreds place ka ank bolo.
lines.4: Boxes har place ka value dikhate hain; ab 2,400 mein tens place ka ank kaunsa hai?
lines.5: Boxes digits ki jagah dikhate hain. Write 'six thousand forty-two' in numbers. Khaali jagah bharo: 4 tens and 2 ones, so the number is ___.
lines.6: Tumne words ko number se joda: “six thousand” matlab 6 hazaar, aur “forty-two” matlab 42. Boxes bas jagah dikhate hain. Write 'six thousand forty-two' in number
lines.7: 6042 sahi hai: tumne 6 hazaar, 4 tens aur 2 ones ko joda. Metro display par depot se station ki doori 'aath hazaar chhah sau chaudah' metre likhi hai. Doori num
lines.8: Ek step check karo: “aath hazaar” ke baad hundreds aur tens alag rakho; tumne beech mein ek extra place jodi. Metro display par depot se station ki doori 'aath
lines.9: Bilkul, 8614: 8 thousands, 6 hundreds, 1 ten, 4 ones. Ab 8614 mein tens digit kaun-sa hai?
lines.10: 8614 mein 1 tens place par hai. 7382 mein 7 ki value kitni hai?
lines.11: 7382 mein 7 ki value 7000 hai, kyunki woh thousands place par hai. 8614 mein 1 ki value batao.
lines.12: “1” digit hai, par tens place mein uski value 10 hoti hai. Teen hazaar paanch sau, aur teen hazaar paanch dahaai. Kya dono same number hain? Dono likho.
lines.13: Tumne hundreds aur tens places ko alag pehchaana: “paanch sau” mein 5 hundreds, “paanch dahaai” mein 5 tens. Teen hazaar paanch sau, aur teen hazaar paanch daha
lines.14: Bilkul, Diya—3500 mein 5 hundreds, 3050 mein 5 tens. Ab batao: dono same kyun nahi hain?
